categories.main_business_segments: Bosideng International Holdings Limited primarily operates in four business segments: branded down apparel, OEM management, ladieswear apparel, and diversified apparel including school uniforms. The branded down apparel segment is the largest contributor, accounting for 83.7% of total revenue, with key brands such as Bosideng, Snow Flying, and Bengen. The OEM management business focuses on manufacturing and design services for other brands. Ladieswear includes mid- to high-end brands like JESSIE, BUOU BUOU, KOREANO, and KLOVA, while diversified apparel covers school uniforms under the Sameite brand and other apparel lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes technological innovation in product development, including new materials, new categories, new technologies, and new techniques. It has developed advanced down apparel technologies such as Dynamic Cold Resistance Technology and integrates AI and 3D technologies in design through its AI Lab. The supply chain employs a demand-pull replenishment model with smart manufacturing and digitalized operations to ensure quick response and high-quality production. The Group also maintains a full-lifecycle quality management system and has established polar environment simulation laboratories for product testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Bosideng serves a broad customer base primarily in the down apparel market, targeting different consumer segments through its multi-brand portfolio. The Bosideng brand targets mainstream consumers seeking fashionable and functional down apparel, Snow Flying focuses on cost-effective mass-market consumers, and Bengen targets younger, quality-conscious customers. The ladieswear brands cater to mid- to high-end female consumers with distinct style preferences. The school uniform business serves over 500 schools, providing functional and fashionable uniforms. The Group also serves international markets through OEM and brand operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's primary market is mainland China, which accounts for the vast majority of its revenue. It also has operations and sales in North America, Europe, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. The Group has manufacturing facilities and joint ventures in Vietnam and Indonesia to support its global supply chain. It is expanding its international presence through strategic investments such as in the Canadian luxury brand Moose Knuckles and the German brand Bogner.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bosideng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manages design, manufacturing (including OEM and ODM), and distribution of apparel products. The Group has vertically integrated supply chain capabilities, including raw material procurement, production, logistics, and retail operations. It also invests in upstream resources such as down raw material suppliers and has established a global supply chain sharing platform to support multi-brand and multi-category operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on becoming the world’s leading fashionable, functional, and technological apparel group, with a dual-focus on core down apparel and fashionable functional apparel enhanced with technology. R&D priorities include new materials, product categories, technologies, and techniques, with significant investment in AI-driven design, smart manufacturing, and supply chain digitalization. The Group also emphasizes sustainable development, aiming for net-zero emissions by 2038 and integrating ESG principles into its operations. Innovation drives product differentiation and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Bosideng generates revenue primarily through product sales of branded down apparel, ladieswear, and diversified apparel. It also earns revenue from OEM and ODM manufacturing services. Sales channels include self-operated retail stores, third-party distributors, and online platforms such as Tmall, JD.com, and Douyin, with a growing proportion of revenue from online sales. The Group also receives government grants and other income related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bosideng positions itself as a leader and expert in the down apparel industry, holding the No.1 sales volume position in China for 30 consecutive years. It competes in various market segments through differentiated brand positioning, from mid-end to high-end and luxury down apparel. The Group faces competition in both domestic and international markets but leverages its strong brand portfolio, technological innovation, and supply chain capabilities to maintain a leading market position. It also competes in the ladieswear and school uniform markets with established brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, Bosideng reported revenue of RMB25.9 billion, representing an 11.6% year-on-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB3.51 billion, up 14.3%, with an operating profit margin of 19.2%. The Group has demonstrated consistent growth with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 16.3% in revenue over recent years. It maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB27.4 billion and a low gearing ratio of 5.3%. The Group's cash flow from operations remains robust, supporting sustainable development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bosideng emphasizes its position as the world’s leading expert in down apparel, offering fashionable, functional, and technologically advanced products. Its value proposition includes high-quality, innovative down apparel with advanced cold resistance technologies suitable for extreme environments, combined with stylish urban designs. The Group differentiates itself through a multi-brand strategy catering to diverse consumer segments, strong brand recognition, and a commitment to sustainability and ESG principles. Its integrated supply chain and digital transformation enable quick response to market demands and superior customer experience.
